zh: 修复在宿主 0.2.3-alpha.2 上最近会话、置顶会话与会话宠物整体停用的问题：宿主把会话状态表从 uiSession 的字段拆成独立的 uiSession.sessionStatus 服务后，旧读取路径直接抛出，现按宿主版本分别读取。
en: Fix the recent and pinned conversation blocks and the chat pet switching off entirely on host 0.2.3-alpha.2: the host moved the session status table off a uiSession field into its own uiSession.sessionStatus service, where the old read path threw outright; the read now follows the host build.
